note: Real parsed data (data/parsed/mars_regions_criteria.csv). Missing criteria are null; the scorer skips them.

regions.name: Jezero Crater
regions.description: Ancient delta and lake basin explored by Perseverance. Carbonates and clays.

regions.name: Gale Crater
regions.description: Mount Sharp layered sediments explored by Curiosity, with clays, sulfates and active dunes.

regions.name: Meridiani Planum
regions.description: Hematite blueberries and jarosite sulfates explored by Opportunity.

regions.name: Utopia Planitia
regions.description: Vast northern plain with scalloped terrain and buried ice.

regions.name: Hellas Planitia
regions.description: Deepest impact basin. Higher pressure, gullies and debris-covered glaciers.

regions.name: Arsia Mons
regions.description: Tharsis shield volcano with lava tubes and cave skylights on its flanks.

regions.name: Olympus Mons
regions.description: The tallest volcano in the Solar System, with basaltic flows and aureole deposits.

regions.name: Candor Chasma
regions.description: Valles Marineris trough with thick layered sulfate deposits.

regions.name: Mawrth Vallis
regions.description: Some of the richest phyllosilicate (clay) layers on Mars.

regions.name: Nili Fossae
regions.description: Carbonate- and olivine-rich troughs near Syrtis Major.

regions.name: Gusev Crater
regions.description: Columbia Hills hydrothermal silica found by Spirit.

regions.name: Arcadia Planitia
regions.description: Shallow, near-surface ice sheets. A candidate site for crewed landings.

regions.name: Phoenix landing site
regions.description: Polygonal ground with excavated water ice and perchlorate salts.

regions.name: Terra Sirenum chlorides
regions.description: Ancient highlands with widespread chloride salt deposits.

regions.name: Russell Crater megadune
regions.description: A giant dune with seasonal frost-driven gullies.

regions.name: Planum Australe
regions.description: South polar layered deposits with a CO₂ and water ice cap.

regions.name: Elysium Mons
regions.description: Volcanic province with young lava flows and collapse pits.
